zh.title: 長榮航空首架客機進場改裝貨機，預計 2027 年投運
zh.summary: 長榮航空在法說會表示，首架客改貨航機已於 11 月中旬進場改裝，預計明年投運，屆時貨機將增至 10 架。
body: 長榮航空 11 月 25 日舉行線上法人說明會。中央社報導，長榮航表示首架由客機改裝的貨機已於 11 月中旬開始改裝，預計 2027 年投入營運。公司規劃第二架於 2027 年、第三架於 2028 年進場，分批擴充貨運機隊。
長榮航空指出，今年前三季貨運營收較去年同期增加 27%。總經理孫嘉明預期，AI 伺服器供應鏈的出貨及醫藥冷鏈需求將支撐明年貨運量。

en.title: EVA Air begins first passenger-to-freighter conversion, targets 2027 entry into service
en.summary: EVA Air told investors that its first passenger aircraft entered freighter conversion in mid-November. It expects to operate ten freighters once the converted aircraft enters service in 2027.
body: EVA Air held an online investor briefing on November 25. According to Taiwan’s Central News Agency, the airline said its first passenger-to-freighter conversion began in mid-November and the aircraft is expected to enter service in 2027. A second aircraft is scheduled to enter conversion in 2027, followed by a third in 2028.

EVA Air said cargo revenue in the first nine months rose 27% year on year. President Clay Sun expects shipments from the AI server supply chain and demand for temperature-controlled pharmaceutical transport to support cargo volumes in 2027.

facts.claim: EVA Air held an online investor conference on November 25.
The first passenger aircraft entered freighter conversion in mid-November. EVA Air expects it to enter service in 2027 and bring its freighter fleet to ten aircraft.
The disclosed schedule has the second conversion starting in 2027 and the third in 2028.
EVA Air reported cargo revenue up 27% year on year in the first nine months. Its president expects AI supply chain shipments and pharmaceutical cold-chain demand to support 2027 cargo volumes.
